texts.preamble: M/S. S.A. Sugandh Pvt. Ltd vs The Chairman on 19 October, 2023 Author: S.K. Panigrahi Bench: S.K. Panigrahi In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack W.P.(C) No.34274 of 2023 M/s. S.A. Sugandh Pvt. Ltd., .... Pe Chhatisgarh Mr. Surya Prasad Mishra, along with a -versus- The Chairman, State Pollution .... Opposite P Control Board, Bhubaneswar & Ors. Mr. Debasish Nayak Mr. Birendra Kumar Padhi Coram: Dr. Justice S.K. Panigrahi Order
texts.facts: The State Pollution Control Board specifically does not attribute any reason for the unit which is polluting in any form. However, on a non-issue which is // 3 // clarified by the State Government as per the above letter, the consent to establish has not granted. Accordingly, the impugned order dated 06.07.2023 was issued to the present Petitioner refusing to grant consent to establish for manufacture of Tobacco and Tobacco products of 2400 TPA from Raw Tobacco, perfume, Kiwam of 2400 TPA under Annexure-4. 6. In the said letter, the State Pollution Control Board, Odisha has stated that the Health and Family Welfare Department has prohibited the manufacture, storage, sale and distribution of Gutkha and Panmasala containing Tobacco/nicotine as the ingredients by whatsoever name available in the market. 7. Considering the letter dated 16.03.2024 issued by the Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Odisha wherein, it has been clearly stated that the Chewing Tobacco is not a prohibited item under Section 30(2)(a) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the communication No.2334/IIICON(NOC/02/2022-23) dated 06.07.2023 issued by the Regional Officer, State Pollution // 4 // Control Board/Opposite Party No.5 and the communication No.14493/IND-IV-BW-3436 dated 13.09.2023 issued by the Chief Environmental Engineer, Bhubaneswar/Opposite Party No.4 are [LEAKAGE_MASK].
texts.arguments: Through the impugned order the application of the Petitioner for obtaining "Consent to Establish" for its "Chewing Tabacco Manufacturing Unit", has been rejected by the authority concerned. 3. Learned Senior Advocate appearing on behalf of the Petitioner submits that such action of the authority is gross violation of the provisions of Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981, the Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974 as well as the provisions of the Cigarettes and other Tabacco Products Act, 2003. He further submits that the Petitioner's approach to the M/S. S.A. Sugandh Pvt. Ltd vs The Chairman on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115287987/ 1 State Pollution Control Board for establishing the Tabacco manufacturing unit does not come within the purview of the Food, Safety and Standards Act, 2006. At the outset, learned counsel for the State brings to the notice of this Court to the letter dated 16.03.2024 issued by the Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Odisha wherein, it has been stated that the product Chewing Tobacco is excluded from the category of the goods prohibited products under the notification No.367 dated 03.01.2013 issued under Section 30(2)(a) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. 5.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Through the impugned order the application of the Petitioner for obtaining "Consent to Establish" for its "Chewing Tabacco Manufacturing Unit", has been rejected by the authority concerned. 3. He further submits that the Petitioner's approach to the M/S. S.A. Sugandh Pvt. Ltd vs The Chairman on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115287987/ 1 State Pollution Control Board for establishing the Tabacco manufacturing unit does not come within the purview of the Food, Safety and Standards Act, 2006. At the outset, learned counsel for the State brings to the notice of this Court to the letter dated 16.03.2024 issued by the Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Odisha wherein, it has been stated that the product Chewing Tobacco is excluded from the category of the goods prohibited products under the notification No.367 dated 03.01.2013 issued under Section 30(2)(a) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. 5.
